_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for user-guide chapter order and numbering. The chapter NUMBER a reader sees is generated from this array position (1-based) by scripts/lib/user-guide-order.mjs -- it is NOT encoded in the filename. To add a chapter: create the file, add one line here in the position it should read, run `npm run build:user-guide-pdf`. Numbering re-flows on its own and no cross-reference breaks, because prose cites chapters by NAME, never by number. Every consumer reads this file: the in-app guide (build-user-guide.mjs), the PDF (build-user-guide-pdf.py), the contents page (build-guide-toc.mjs), and the staleness hash (user-guide-hash.mjs). index.md is the contents page, not a numbered chapter. Filenames are stable slugs; do not rename them again.
